status: proposed documentary control and evidence mapping; no guardrail or test execution asserted
scope: Seven selected requirements; objective numbers are publisher-local, not canonical RAHP IDs.

distinctions.control: Proposed treatment or existing requirement-level protection
distinctions.guardrail: A candidate invariant whose violation would warrant examination; no verified binary guardrail result
distinctions.assurance_test: Proposed evidence-generating activity; not executed against a deployment

cross_cutting_risk: EX-RK-HX04 applies to any unsupported inference of operational equivalence from documentary evidence.

records.control: Maintain physical issuance and acceptance, independent of digital enrollment; review the acceptance inventory.
records.assurance_test: Sample physical issuance and acceptance at actual service points; inspect inventory freshness and eligibility rules.
records.guardrail: No unsupported assertion of effective service parity or non-compulsion; a missing observation remains unknown.

records.control: Maintain complete pathway inventory, usable fallback, non-compulsion policies, staff training and grievance mechanisms.
records.assurance_test: Compare inventory to service catalog; exercise internal and external fallback; observe staff intake and grievance handling.
records.guardrail: No unsupported assertion of effective service parity or non-compulsion; a missing observation remains unknown.

records.control: Maintain format-neutral service conditions, limit distinctions, bind relying-party agreements and provide complaint channels.
records.authority: Governmental entities, health care providers and relying parties (government service only exercised)
records.assurance_test: Compare matched service outcomes, fees and delays; inspect permitted distinctions, agreements and complaint handling.
records.guardrail: No unsupported assertion of effective service parity or non-compulsion; a missing observation remains unknown.

records.control: Remove enrollment prerequisites and possession assumptions from service pathways and agreements.
records.assurance_test: Exercise enrollment-free intake and fallback; inspect integration agreements and staff practices.
records.guardrail: No unsupported assertion of effective service parity or non-compulsion; a missing observation remains unknown.

records.control: Prohibit SEDI-linked preferential treatment and incentives; maintain service parity.
records.assurance_test: Compare fee schedules, processing times, incentives and workflows for the same entitlement.
records.guardrail: No unsupported assertion of effective service parity or non-compulsion; a missing observation remains unknown.

records.control: Retain physical acceptance, prevent degradation and provide complaint mechanisms.
records.assurance_test: Observe physical acceptance and paired outcomes; test complaint accessibility and remediation.
records.guardrail: No unsupported assertion of effective service parity or non-compulsion; a missing observation remains unknown.

records.control: Document infeasibility or specific-format legal basis; obtain Department review and track remediation. Do not infer authority to mandate SEDI.
records.authority: Governmental entities; Department reviews infeasibility claims
records.assurance_test: Inspect case-specific basis, review decision, timeline and progress; check exception direction.
records.guardrail: No unsupported assertion of effective service parity or non-compulsion; a missing observation remains unknown.
